title: Anyone else made it to a middle level train station of the Mallword?
content: About a week ago, I randomly became lucid within the tail end of a Mallworld dream. I was standing in the middle of a candy/toy shop that was built above a huge warehouse that looked like a mix of irl Ikea and Home Depot. The mini shop was only half finished but with bright fashion studio-like lighting, and was essentially built right under a top corner of the warehouse roof. Looking down over the railing of the mini shop, there were about 3 large cargo drop-off doors to the left, lots of random products (a random mix of large toys and usual hardware store items) on the tall wall shelves to the right. Then I turned around and out of the mini shop and found myself in a fancy, early-2000s era looking lobby with large, lightly teal frosted windows looking out to a train rail and small station there right next to the windows. To my left was a mall entrance way with no doors looking out to a large parking lot where each individual parking spot was sided by those planted medians with trees and bushes (instead of the medians being on the edges of each row of parking spots like irl). For some reason the dream faded before I could think of walking to the train. I notice my experiences in the mallworld are always in random parts of it, almost like I "spawn in" to the mallworld in random locations in each dream, kindof like some video games irl.
